statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 4, low, because CME equity index futures have been shut since Friday at 21:00Z and no Nasdaq-100 price path can form in any of the first twenty-three hours published here; only the final slot, which begins at the scheduled 22:00Z Sunday reopen, contains a tradable interval, and it carries a conditional Tail of 12 that stays well below the block threshold. Stress is 39, moderate: a 50% US tariff on Canadian goods is live after the collapse of trade talks, Canada has dated a dollar-for-dollar match to 8 September, the 20 August H.15 column shows 4.19% at two years, 4.69% at ten and 5.23% at thirty with the long end at its highest since 2007, and Brent at $94.39 with WTI at $87.06 completes a second consecutive weekly energy gain against an unresolved US-Iran conflict. Confidence is 87, high: closing levels, yields, energy prices, volatility and the seven-day calendar are all verified, and the only material gap is the absence of a live price path, which is a property of the weekend halt rather than of the evidence.
recommendation: The last observed session remains consistent with functioning mean reversion rather than a one-way path: cash NDX opened at 29,359.60, traded down to 29,142.44, recovered to 29,405.12 and closed at 29,308.86, below its own open and up 0.33% on the day, while QQQ closed 0.35% higher at 713.44 and the VIX settled at 14.89, near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range. Both session extremes were retraced and neither produced repeated extension after a failed pullback, so no Tail amplifier carries over from observed structure. Friday internals were split rather than aligned, with software firm, semiconductors 0.31% lower and megacaps five to three higher on dispersion of about 1.82 percentage points. Because the venue is closed for twenty-three of the twenty-four hours published here, the first Tail-relevant evidence can only come from prints after the 22:00Z Sunday reopen: whether early pullbacks are retraced, whether the index holds near a session extreme, and whether yields, volatility and energy align in one direction. Until then the weekend backdrop is described as moderate and rising Stress with Tail at its closed-venue floor.
headline: Closed-venue assessment with the Sunday reopen now inside the horizon: Tail holds the floor of 4 through twenty-three shut hours, then carries a conditional 12 in the 22:00Z reopen slot, while live US tariffs on Canadian goods, a post-2007 long end and a second week of energy gains stay unpriced.
body: CME Globex equity index futures stopped trading for the week on Friday at 21:00Z and are scheduled to reopen on Sunday at 22:00Z. The twenty-four slots published here run from 2026-08-22T23:00:00Z to 2026-08-23T22:00:00Z, so for the first time this weekend the final slot begins exactly at the reopen and contains a tradable interval. Cash NDX settled at 29,308.86 on Friday, up 0.33%, after opening at 29,359.60 and printing a 29,142.44 low and a 29,405.12 high; both extremes were retraced inside the session and the close finished below the open. One widely used quote page again returned an inconsistent Nasdaq-100 level and direction for the same session, so the levels published here follow the source set that agrees with QQQ's verified 0.35% gain to 713.44. On policy, the 50% US tariff on Canadian goods took effect after the Friday midnight deadline under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, an authority not previously used to impose tariffs; reported coverage ranges from about US$20bn to US$28bn of goods across outlets, negotiations collapsed with no further rounds scheduled, and Ottawa has dated a matching response across steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper and electronics to 8 September. That second step falls outside both this horizon and the coming week, which is why it is scored as Stress rather than as an imminent Tail path. Rates remain the slower pressure with the long end at its highest since 2007, while Brent at $94.39 and WTI at $87.06 reflect a second consecutive weekly gain against an unresolved US-Iran conflict; the US Treasury has said details of new Iran measures will be presented at a Monday press conference, whose exact time is unconfirmed and which therefore is not listed as a calendar event. The coming week is dense: PCE and Nvidia's results collide on Wednesday and the Jackson Hole keynote follows on Friday, all beyond the end of this forecast. Delayed last-session cross-asset context was reviewed as supporting evidence only and was not treated as a substitute for live price-path evidence, which does not exist while the venue is closed.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past 24 hours is nearly complete: 21 hourly assessments are available, while the 05:00Z, 06:00Z and 21:00Z clock-hours have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. Across every available hour Tail held 4 and the mapped policy state stayed EA_ON, so no hour approached the block threshold and the dominant mode remained normal throughout. Stress traced a shallow arc: 37 at the start of the window, a 35-36 overnight trough, a rebuild to 42 through the middle of Saturday as the tariff deadline passed and the Canadian response was dated, then an easing to 40 into the evening. Confidence stayed in an 84-88 band, reflecting verified closing levels and macro data against the absence of any live price path. Nothing in the window contains observed one-way structure, because no venue was open to produce it.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 4 because CME equity index futures are confirmed halted and no Nasdaq-100 price path can develop inside this slot. The following twenty-two slots describe the same closed market, so Tail holds 4 and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON throughout them. The final slot begins at the scheduled 22:00Z Sunday reopen and is the only tradable interval in the horizon: it carries a conditional Tail of 12, still green, on thin early liquidity and an unretraced-gap scenario rather than on any observed structure, and it is the only reason a narrow danger window is published at all. Stress eases from 39 to a 37 trough through the quiet Saturday night and Sunday overnight hours, then rebuilds steadily to 46 in the final closed hour and 52 in the reopen slot as the weekend information set converges on a single opening auction. Confidence decays from 87 to 74 across the horizon, driven by the ageing of Friday's close as the last live observation. Any Tail reassessment depends on prints after the reopen: whether early pullbacks are retraced, whether the index holds near an extreme, and whether yields, volatility and energy align.
